name: io.github.ianderso/contentdm-mcp
title: CONTENTdm State Archives
description: Search US state archives' record images on CONTENTdm; read items, pages and transcripts.

environmentVariables.name: CONTENTDM_CACHE_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Directory for the on-disk response cache.

environmentVariables.name: CONTENTDM_TIMEOUT
environmentVariables.description: HTTP timeout in seconds for one request. Image downloads get 120 s to read.

environmentVariables.name: CONTENTDM_MIN_INTERVAL
environmentVariables.description: Least seconds between two requests to one site. Never below 0.5.

environmentVariables.name: CONTENTDM_CONTACT
environmentVariables.description: An email address or URL appended to the User-Agent, so an institution can reach whoever runs the server.
